limitationStatic: Static context only: no audited application or tests were executed.
limitationMerge: Target integration/merge-result analysis was not performed.
limitationSecrets: Secret filtering is best-effort: inspect all content before sharing with an agent/provider.
limitationClauses: Requirement paragraphs are intake units, not automatically approved semantic clauses.
limitationWorktreeUnknown: Worktree status unknown: configured Git clean/process filters prevent safe status checking; uncommitted content is ignored.
limitationRepoMoved: Repository location differs from frozen snapshot.
limitationRepoUnavailable: Repository or tracked ref unavailable; freshness unknown.
limitationTraversal: Python AST traversal limit; file-level fallback
title: dsh-spec-test-gap · Evidence workbench
subtitle: Compare independent requirements with frozen committed changes. Inspect evidence before recording a local judgment.
empty: No registered workspaces. Create one in DSH first.
sessionHelp: Resident means loaded, not executing or authenticated. Selection grants no authority; Host revalidates each action.
sessionRequired: Select a resident Session to inspect model routes and send. Offline and historical work do not require one.
offline: Preparation reads committed Git objects and independent requirements. It sends nothing to a provider and executes no audited code.
relativeOnly: Path relative to the selected workspace; no absolute paths or parent traversal.
head: H · Head
baseHelp: H is the feature tip. T is optional; M is its merge base with H. Explicit B overrides M; otherwise M or H’s parent is used. No merge-result analysis is performed.
requirementsLimit: Nonblank, valid Unicode, no NUL. Maximum 1,048,576 UTF-8 bytes.
attestationDisclaimer: Actor names and roles are local self-attestations, not authenticated identity. Replies, intent decisions, disposition, verification and release approval are separate.
demoHelp: Generates a private sample repository and a scripted review. No model, no audited project execution; not a model-quality benchmark.
noReview: No validated review yet. This is not a zero-findings result.
zeroFindings: The validated review reports zero findings. This is not proof of correctness or release approval.
dirtyUnknown: Working-tree status is unknown. Uncommitted content is not reviewed.
dirtyIgnored: Uncommitted or untracked changes were ignored; only frozen committed objects were reviewed.
stale: Stale or unknown freshness. Prepare a new snapshot; refreshing event history does not repair Git or requirements changes.
releaseDisclaimer: Review aid only. No release approval, correctness guarantee or independently executed verification.
noEvidence: No captured citation. Absence of evidence is not proof of absence.
chooseActor: Select an actor from the frozen policy…
manualOnly: Evidence is inert manual text. dsh-spec-test-gap does not run tests. Passed verification requires an earlier decision; a newer decision invalidates prior verification status.
evidenceLimit: Maximum 65,536 UTF-8 bytes; nonblank valid Unicode without NUL.
textLimit: 1–12,000 UTF-16 units; valid Unicode without NUL.
attestLocal: I explicitly attest locally under the selected frozen actor / role policy.
modelDisclosure: Inspect every byte before sending, including source content. The complete effective request is recorded in a plugin-private per-attempt audit, NOT the native Session conversation log. Secret filtering is best-effort.
oneAttempt: One attempt per run; no automatic retry. Preview and confirmation expire after 10 minutes and are single-use. Invalid output is not a validated review.
catalogFailures: Some catalog routes failed to load; no substitute route is selected.
previewRequest: Preview exact outgoing request — no send
exactRequest: Complete effective request, template and binding
sendConsent: I inspected the complete effective request, source content, route, effort, budget and private logging disclosure. I consent to one provider transmission.
sendOnce: Send once to the selected provider
expired: Preview expired. Create and inspect a new preview.
analysisSubmitted: Submission was attempted. Refresh the run to inspect durable attempt status. An interrupted HTTP response does not prove that the native job stopped. Do not resend.
viewExportHelp: JSON is the public run view returned by Host, not an importable review or portable backup.
attemptFailure: Attempt failed or was interrupted; no findings are inferred from invalid output.
cancelHelp: Cancellation targets this exact run / Session / attempt. Aborting an HTTP request alone is not native cancellation. Refresh to observe the result.
noHistory: No saved runs in this workspace.
mutation_committed: Action committed. Review the refreshed authoritative state before recording another intent.
mutation_committedRefreshFailed: Action committed, but refreshing the run failed. Do not submit it again; only refresh.
mutation_ambiguous: Outcome is ambiguous. The original complete payload and key are retained; do not create a fresh duplicate. STALE or an exact-recovery CONFLICT can follow a durable commit; a run read alone cannot settle the original receipt.
mutation_conflict: Conflict. Review refreshed authoritative state, then acknowledge before creating a new intent. No automatic token substitution.
mutation_rejected: Action definitively rejected. Review the error before acknowledging and creating a new intent.
recoveryHelp: Recovery replays only the identical retained payload/key under the original selection. It does not approve a changed action or automatically retry a model call.
acknowledge: I reviewed this result / refreshed state
foreignPending: A retained intent belongs to another selection. New mutations are blocked; no previous content is shown here.
parkForSnapshot: Retain this unresolved intent; prepare a NEW snapshot
parkedIntent: An unresolved human intent (STALE or exact-recovery CONFLICT) remains retained for exact recovery. A new snapshot is independent and does not cancel or undo the old operation; revisiting the old run blocks fresh duplicates even under another Session.
recoveryPrivacy: This tab’s session storage retains one active intent and at most seven explicitly parked unresolved human intents, including submitted text, within 8 MiB. Acknowledge settled results to erase them. Closing the tab can lose recovery information; inspect history before starting anew.
tryDemo: Try a complete review in one click
comparisonTitle: Choose the committed changes to compare
requirementsTitle: Describe what this change should do
comparisonHelp: Committed changes only. Nothing is sent to a model at this step.
advancedComparison: Advanced · comparison base and context limits
confirmActors: I have checked these named participants and their exact local roles for this review.
preparedHelp: The frozen snapshot is saved and can be inspected or reported offline. No model request has been sent; this is not a completed review.
runUnavailable: The selected run is not loaded. Refresh to read its authoritative state; no cached review is shown.
conversationSwitchHelp: The report lives in the native Conversation sidebar. Confirm to leave this workbench and switch to a resident Session in this workspace. Your selected review and finding are retained; this does not send a chat or model request.
reportNoSession: No resident Session is available in this workspace. Open one in Conversation, then return and refresh. Offline exports remain available.
openingReport: Switching to Conversation and opening the report…
reportOpenFailed: The report could not be opened. No automatic retry was made. Return to the workbench and refresh available Sessions before trying again.
priorityOrder: Highest severity first · inspect evidence before deciding
noEvents: No local records for this finding yet.
noMapping: No entries in this validated review section.
noRecordedLimitations: No additional limitations were recorded. This is not proof of complete coverage.
historyHelp: Open a saved run to inspect its current authoritative state. Preparation and failed attempts are not validated reviews.
historyEmptyHelp: Start a new review or try the offline demo above.
modelCostHelp: Optional: a model review sends requirements and source code to the provider and may incur charges. Preview the full request and explicitly consent before sending once.
modelNotReady: The selected Session or native model-dispatch capability is unavailable. Refresh the environment or choose another resident Session; the prepared snapshot remains usable offline.
advancedModel: Advanced · reasoning effort and bounded budget
sourceUnavailable: No complete, locatable frozen source was saved. The quotation is retained; no current file is substituted.
sourceContext: Expand context (10 lines either side, up to 200 lines)
sourceFrozenHelp: Read-only content saved for this review, not the current working-tree file. Cited lines are highlighted; long files use 200-line pages.
error_INVALID_INPUT: Check the input fields and byte limits.
error_FORBIDDEN: Host rejected access or path containment.
error_NOT_FOUND: The selected item was not found.
error_CONFLICT: State changed or conflicts with this intent. Review a refreshed run before acting.
error_STALE: Selection or snapshot is stale. Restore the original selection for recovery; changed Git or requirements require a new snapshot.
error_CANCELLED: Request cancelled; a mutation may already have committed.
error_TIMEOUT: Request timed out; inspect durable history before another action.
error_INVALID_REVIEW: Output was invalid. No validated findings are available from this attempt.
error_UNAVAILABLE: Service or network unavailable. No automatic retry was made.
error_INTEGRITY: Artifact integrity could not be validated. Do not treat this as a successful review.
error_INTERNAL: Operation failed. Inspect the request reference; no automatic retry was made.
error_RECOVERY_STORAGE: Tab recovery storage is unavailable or invalid. No new mutation is sent without saving its recovery intent.
